arms.graph: ew-select-3 on graph evidence at freeze time (parent or scratch)
arms.graph_v2: ew-select-2 on the same graph, for contrast
arms.latest: latest created_at among eligible library checkpoints
arms.best_val: max (success_rate - collision_rate) on val-target-v1, ties by policy id

notes: Identical (parent, seed) pairs are computed once and shared between arms that agree. Every run is recorded as a Trial and ingested, so the graph keeps learning after selection.
